exhibits.title: Spot Price
exhibits.statement: Solana (SOL) traded at $95.7200 as of 2026-10-31 13:14:48 UTC, +0.21% over one hour and -0.75% over twenty-four hours.

exhibits.title: 24-Hour Trading Range
exhibits.statement: Over twenty-four hours the price ranged from $93.5700 to $96.9400; spot sits at 64% of that range.

exhibits.title: Seven-Day Trend
exhibits.statement: Price is -5.36% over seven days. The 24-hour average ($95.4786) is below the 72-hour average ($98.0969). Spot is 6.99% below the seven-day high of $102.91 and 2.30% above the seven-day low of $93.5700.

exhibits.title: Volatility & Momentum
exhibits.statement: Realized volatility computed from hourly closes is 3.02% per day. The 14-hour relative strength index reads 49.2, conventionally neutral.

exhibits.title: Liquidity
exhibits.statement: Twenty-four-hour trading volume was $2.91 billion, equal to 5.16% of the $56.48 billion market capitalization.

exhibits.title: Market Sentiment
exhibits.statement: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 30 ("Fear"), versus 51 7 days earlier.

exhibits.title: Chainlink Price Feed
exhibits.statement: The Chainlink SOL/USD Data Feed on Ethereum mainnet last reported $96.8785, 11.6 hours before the spot quote and +1.21% against the spot price in Exhibit A. Practice positions are entered and settled at this mark.

arguments.text:
May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price of SOL sits comfortably above the 24‑hour low and 64% up the daily range, indicating a price floor at $93.57 that has held despite a modest 0.21% hourly uptick, so a long practice position is poised to capture upside within the bounded range [Ex. A, B].  

2. Market liquidity is robust, with $2.91 billion traded in the last day—5.16% of market cap—ensuring order execution without slippage, while the neutral RSI of 49.2 signals no immediate over‑bought pressure to cap gains [Ex. D, E].  

3. Sentiment has shifted to fear (index 30) from neutral (51) a week ago, a classic contrarian signal that buyers will step in, and the Chainlink feed, priced at $96.8785, is already 1.21% above the spot, offering a favorable entry point for the practice trade [Ex. F, G].  

The Bull rests.

May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price of SOL is trading at $95.72, well within the lower two‑thirds of its 24‑hour range at 64% of that band, indicating limited upside momentum and a price that remains below both the 72‑hour average and the seven‑day high [Ex. A, B, C].  

2. Realized volatility is modest at 3.02% per day, and the RSI sits at a neutral 49.2, showing no bullish catalyst to trigger a breakout; combined with a 5‑day decline of 5.36% and a fear‑driven sentiment index of 30, the market lacks the thrust needed for a short‑term rally [Ex. D, C, F].  

3. The Chainlink price feed, the settlement benchmark, posted $96.8785, a full 1.21% premium to the spot quote, confirming that any short‑position entered at the feed would be priced above the current market, providing an immediate edge for the Bear [Ex. G, A].  

The Bear rests.

Your Honor, the Bear’s claim of “limited upside” ignores that the spot sits at 64 % of its 24‑hour range, leaving 36 % of upward space still untapped; the range’s high of $96.94 is only 1.3 % above current price, a trivial gap that a modest rally can close quickly [Ex. B]. Moreover, the Bear touts “modest” volatility at 3.02 % per day as bearish, yet that level is well above the 1‑%‑2 % range typical of stagnant markets and is sufficient to fuel short‑term breakouts, especially when paired with a neutral RSI of 49.2 that signals no resistance to upward momentum [Ex. D]. Nothing further.

Your Honor, the Bull’s first pillar collapses under the seven‑day trend: SOL is down 5.36% over the week and sits 6.99% below its recent high, proving the “floor” at $93.57 is eroding, not sturdy [Ex. C]. Moreover, the 24‑hour average ($95.4786) remains below the 72‑hour average ($98.0969), indicating downward momentum that neutralizes any modest hourly gain [Ex. C].  

The Bull’s second pillar misreads sentiment. The Fear & Greed Index at 30 signals pervasive market dread, not a contrarian buying surge; historically, such fear depresses demand and suppresses price appreciation [Ex. F].  

Nothing further.

ruling.holding: The Court finds a short practice position is warranted.

findings.finding: Spot price is $95.72, down 0.75% over 24h and 5.36% over seven days, indicating bearish short‑term trend
Seven‑day high is $102.91, current price 6.99% below it and 24h average below 72h average, showing downward momentum
Fear & Greed Index at 30 (Fear) versus 51 a week earlier, reflecting negative sentiment
Chainlink settlement feed is $96.8785, 1.21% above spot, giving an immediate price advantage to short entrants

ruling.opinion: The evidence shows SOL is in a downtrend across multiple horizons, with price below recent averages and a fear‑driven sentiment environment. The settlement feed trades above spot, creating a short‑side edge. Neutral volatility and RSI do not offset these bearish signals, so the Court authorizes a short practice position.
ruling.dissent: The Bull argues the remaining 36% of the daily range and modest volatility allow upside, but the prevailing downtrend, fear sentiment, and higher settlement price outweigh those points.
